svg.text: Find F by sending a ray that emerges parallel to the axis; extensions locate P.

g.data-original-text: <text x="210.0" y="284" text-anchor="middle" class="lbl">f = front effective focal length</text>
g.title: f = front effective focal length

svg.text: Any ray leaving F (front focal point) emerges from the system parallel to the axis.
Identify such an emergent ray on the image side at height h.
Dashed extensions meet at height h on the front principal plane P.
